Database: The People's Choice Awards Database. Run: python3 demo.py (standard library only)."""

TITLE = "Founded 1975"

  "Founded 1975",
  "Producer Bob Stivers founded the People's Choice Awards in 1975 to let audiences — not the industry — pick the winners."
]

def word_count():
    return sum(len(p.split()) for p in TEXT)

def reading_guide():
    return ["Paragraph %%d: %%s..." %% (i + 1, p[:70]) for i, p in enumerate(TEXT)]

if __name__ == "__main__":

    print(TITLE)
    print("=" * 64)
    for p in TEXT:
        print()
        print(p)
    print()
    print("--- reading guide ---")
    for g in reading_guide():
        print(" ", g)
    print("words:", word_count())
